findings.title: findingfrancesca_
findings.snippet:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in Punta Cana and I already want to go back. From the second we got there, the entire resort just felt peaceful. Even though the property is huge, it somehow never felt overcrowded, which made the experience feel so much more luxurious and relaxing.

If you like calmer, more elevated vibes, I definitely recommend staying at The Reserve, which is the adults-only section. Our suite was absolutely stunning with the most beautiful view and honestly became one of my favorite resort rooms I’ve stayed in.

There are over 5 pools, 8 restaurants, and the food genuinely surprised us in the best way possible because if you travel a lot, you know all-inclusive food can be very hit or miss 😅 but every meal here was SO good.

What I also loved is that there was always something to do besides just laying by the pool. They had aerial yoga, coffee-making classes, pizza-making workshops, cigar rolling, wellness activities, and so much more throughout the day. It really felt like the perfect mix of relaxing and fun.

If Punta Cana has been on your bucket list, this is your sign to book it ✈️ Save this for your future trip and send it to the person you’d bring here with you 🤍

#puntacana #allinclusiveresort #dominicanrepublic #luxurytravel #paradisuspalmareal

findings.title: tripswithkatelyn
findings.snippet:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort is calling your name.

March 31 | 7 Nights
From Toronto
2 Adults
Junior Suite Garden View – Adults Only
$2,465 per person ($4,930 total)

If you’ve been waiting for the perfect excuse to escape to Punta Cana, this is it. Seven nights of luxury, incredible food, white sand beaches, and adults-only relaxation.

Here’s why this one stands out:

✔ Adults-Only Section – quieter atmosphere, elevated service, perfect for couples
✔ Beautiful Bavaro Beach location with calm, swimmable turquoise water
✔ Multiple à la carte restaurants + premium drinks included
✔ Stunning pools and modern tropical design throughout
✔ YHI Spa for full relaxation mode
✔ Access to Cocotal Golf & Country Club – a gorgeous 27-hole course. Complimentary green fees are typically included (cart fees extra), which is a huge perk if you or your partner love to golf

This is such a good option for couples wanting luxury without going over the top on price. March weather in Punta Cana is perfect, and these rates do not stick around.

If you’re thinking about it, message me and let’s secure it before it’s gone. #traveladvisor #traveladvisorlife #travelplanning #TravelAdvisor #vacationmode
